package.json:
{
  "name": "bluu-client",
  "version": "0.4.29",
  "description": "Bluu Client \u00b7 Minecraft Java",
  "author": "Blu",
  "license": "MIT",
  "main": "main.cjs",
  "scripts": {
    "start": "electron .",
    "dist": "node build-portable.cjs",
    "dist:signed": "electron-builder --config electron-builder-signed.cjs --win portable --x64"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "extract-zip": "2.0.1",
    "minecraft-launcher-core": "3.18.2",
    "msmc": "5.0.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "electron": "39.2.7",
    "electron-builder": "26.0.12",
    "skinview3d": "3.4.2",
    "electron-winstaller": "5.4.0"
  },
  "build": {
    "appId": "studio.blu.launcher",
    "productName": "Bluu Client",
    "files": [
      "main.cjs",
      "preload.cjs",
      "pack.cjs",
      "runtime.cjs",
      "index.html",
      "renderer.js",
      "style.css",
      "assets/**",
      "pack-config.json",
      "update.cjs",
      "avatar.cjs",
      "appearance.cjs",
      "mod-guard.cjs",
      "resource-packs.cjs",
      "theme.cjs",
      "auto-update.cjs",
      "shortcut.cjs",
      "session-restore.cjs",
      "access.cjs",
      "updater-process.cjs",
      "image-assets.cjs",
      "instances.cjs",
      "player-directory.cjs"
    ],
    "win": {
      "target": "portable",
      "signAndEditExecutable": false,
      "artifactName": "Bluu-Client.exe",
      "icon": "assets/studio.ico",
      "executableName": "Bluu-Client"
    },
    "portable": {
      "requestExecutionLevel": "user",
      "useZip": false
    },
    "compression": "normal",
    "directories": {
      "output": "dist-0429"
    },
    "electronLanguages": [
      "es",
      "es-419",
      "en-US"
    ]
  }
}
